name: Kernel-Reflection Sequences
definition: A procedural modeling approach composed of kernel geometries defined by signed distance functions and reflection transformations. It allows evaluation of a global distance function without recursion, enabling real-time sphere tracing on parallel hardware.
summary: Kernel-Reflection Sequences generate fractal geometries via non-recursive Signed Distance Functions, enabling real-time GPU sphere tracing without the divergent control flow of traditional Iterated Function Systems.
